problem_keywords: cancelled link delete miscounted as applied
propositions: When ACLI link delete is cancelled due to confirmation prompt reading EOF via subprocess.DEVNULL, the CalledProcessError is incorrectly counted as an applied link instead of a failure, fabricating success in batch_outcome reporting

The narrowed idempotent check for link deletion must match both stderr and stdout combined for markers like 404, 409, does-not-exist, and not-found, not stderr alone, to avoid false-negative classification of concurrent removals
link create and link delete subcommands both accept --yes flag to suppress confirmation prompts, mirroring the pattern already established in workitem delete to prevent EOF-induced cancellations
A new links_failed counter must be added and carried through the outcome dict to make failure cases visible in batch_outcome, enabling the silent-noop canary to detect permanent divergence
CalledProcessError on link operations with no idempotent marker on either stream must increment links_failed and print diagnostically without unwinding the pass
